purpose: S072 joint compact transfer state, quantum frequency bound and matrix-junction stress comparison

sources.reading_scope: Sections 2.1.1, 2.1.2 and 3.1 reread in full. LLL charge/spin representation, actual fermion boundary bilinear and boundary conditions; corrected on-shell Hamiltonian accounting. Their magnetic charge Q_R=-Q_L=q/g is not the fluctuating unit electric charge Q in the compact comparison. No claim that their static solution proves our formation or state matching.

Section 2 read in full: Gauss constraint, link operators, separately dressed charged fields and failure of naive bulk spatial tensor factorization. Used to distinguish an extended link Hilbert space from already dressed boundary operators. No adoption of the paper's broader quantum-gravity or weak-gravity arguments.

inherited_evidence.role: Compact comparison, fixed-source coefficients, causal mean response and free switching benchmark. None identifies the physical interacting compact/fermion state.

derivation_scope: The quotient lattice follows from the stated seed and field representations. Thermal affinity, energy-weighted sum and second-moment inequalities are derived explicitly; no novelty claim for these methods. Matrix flux is independently point-split for a prescribed classical group history.
limitations: Additional seed sectors or field species can change the lattice
The physical compact Hamiltonian, its sector weights and neutral-fermion factorization are unproved
The finite-time compact bound concerns free pair evolution, not switching backreaction
A classical matrix history does not supply quantum mixed correlators or renormalized stress
No full four-dimensional formation, preparation or sufficient stability claim
